ranked.text: Demand vendor payloads violate the ingestion contract, causing demand batch failures while weather ingestion is unaffected.
Upstream demand telemetry from grid-telemetry is incomplete or stale, causing ingestion demand batch failures.
Demand ingestion batches are timing out or running slowly, causing demand batch failures independent of contract or completeness problems.
A recent ingestion rollout or GitOps change introduced a defect affecting demand ingestion.
